notes: The marginal note offering gave for offerings was read and set aside under rule 38.
kids fuses two morphemes into one English word; the head was put on the lexical noun goats, with the young morpheme the competing candidate.

all of them: rule 19 forbids a kol -> all of division only where a suffix is written to take of them, and this kol is absolute with no suffix, so the supplied of them completes the substantival quantifier under rule 31 and the article is unrepresented for want of a written the.
